title: Stochastic Gradient Descent for Traffic and Pedestrian Models via Neural Networks and Parameter Identification
summary: We study the calibration of interaction-driven ordinary differential equation (ODE) models for traffic and pedestrian dynamics by means of optimal control and stochastic gradient descent. The interaction forces are either prescribed by classical physics-inspired laws, whose parameters are identified from trajectory data, or represented by feed-forward neural networks whose weights act as control variables. For the neural-network-driven particle system we prove well-posedness of the state equation, Lipschitz-continuous dependence of the trajectories on the initial data and on the network…
